Name: Tiger Woods PGA TOUR 12
Description: EA's golf simulation, played across licensed courses with the swing controlled by touch.

Achievements.Name: I got this
Achievements.Description: From the Fairway, land within 1 yard of the flagstick from at least 100 yards away

Achievements.Name: Ping !
Achievements.Description: Hit the ball off the flagstick with a drive or approach

Achievements.Name: Ace in the Hole !
Achievements.Description: Sink a Hole in One

Achievements.Name: Fly like a Bird
Achievements.Description: Score a Birdie

Achievements.Name: Soar like an Eagle
Achievements.Description: Score an Eagle (a hole played in two strokes under par)

Achievements.Name: Sink it like an Albatross
Achievements.Description: A hole played three strokes under par. Also called a Double Eagle.

Achievements.Name: The trophy maker!
Achievements.Description: Win a PGA Tour

Achievements.Name: Play Through
Achievements.Description: Finish a PGA tour

Achievements.Name: Take on the Tiger
Achievements.Description: Complete a Tiger Challenge

Achievements.Name: Tiger Cup
Achievements.Description: Complete all Tiger Challenges

Achievements.Name: Par for the course
Achievements.Description: Make Par on every hole on a course

Achievements.Name: Inconceivable!
Achievements.Description: Birdie on every hole on a course

Achievements.Name: What a rocket!
Achievements.Description: Drive a ball farther than 350 yards (Tiger's Record)

Achievements.Name: What a Wogan!
Achievements.Description: Sink a putt longer than 55 feet

Achievements.Name: Green in regulation
Achievements.Description: Touch the putting surface with a number of strokes taken of two fewer than par

Achievements.Name: Sand-y Dunkin'
Achievements.Description: Sink the ball from a sand trap

Achievements.Name: Make it Rain
Achievements.Description: Earn $3,000,000 in a year

Achievements.Name: Hazard Save
Achievements.Description: Make par after having been in a bunker

Achievements.Name: Play with friends
Achievements.Description: Play with friends

Achievements.Name: Win 5 multiplayer games.
Achievements.Description: Win 5 multiplayer games.
